entry_points.text: Zspage scans fullness bands high to low; write errors record only if still mapped; eviction builds shadows with demotion and node ordering.
Per-vector shrink loops budget and bounded evict batches via isolation; walk restarts at user start, try-locks mm and flushes.
One memcg reclaim build is null; shrink, frag scoring, percpu first-chunk setup and slab availability gate form boot and reclaim entries.
First chunk maps one unit per CPU with unwind; NUMA uses firmware or synthetic node; BDI init links writeback state.
Async cgwb cleanup reclaims to quiescence; init sets release work and trees; debug and sysfs expose per-area controls.

exports.text: Size selects class with floor and cap; scanned swap writeout succeeds without I/O; stats give monotonic clamped node and zone sums.
Public shrink dispatch, compaction suitability probe, cgroup generation release and hopeless-state clear form stable reclaim entry points.
Sheaf exchange plus bulk refill serve CPU and node paths; bottom-up memblock finder supports node-aware early allocation.
Early grants honor ceiling with retry, loose node preference and slab fallback; reservation stays disjoint with coalescing and ordered search.
NUMA ranges publish after cleaning; writeback gives global and cgroup dirty shares, validated limits and parent release.
Devices register with increasing ids and hide-then-shutdown teardown; CMA allocates frozen with retry; frozen ranges free via common helper.

hazards.text: Busy freezes count before dirty test; min stalls on exhaustion; max over stuck risks inversion; partial build releases cleanly.
One gen-shrink variant fails the build; fenced batch rejected; shrink and charge constants bound behavior; charging stays bounded with unwind.
Late early calls warn to slab semantics; partial first-chunk unwinds; bad emulation abandons to prior nodes.
Tree collision reports success for loser with revalidation; teardown hides before shutdown; contended CMA retries elsewhere; returning referenced pages warns.
Freeing walks by address with splits; cursor and bitmap share by phase; release clears link; unpoison precedes init, sanitizer precedes tags.

invariants.text: Metadata uses dedicated unmovable caches; zspages carry pool and class identity; backing pages are singly flagged, counted and buddy-returned.
Removal needs locked matching folio, rejects dirty, installs live file shadows; zone counts use per-CPU deltas with hysteresis.
Legacy swapout charges online ancestor to swap counters; root sums global states; shadows fold group, node and aged clock.
Balance picks scan shares from hints with protection scaling; anon aging needs swap or demotion; isolation takes an extra ref.
Debt claimed atomically with scaled pressure capped at twice freeable; deferred folds NUMA id with memcg-aware wrapped bins.
Priority sizes from reclaimables, balance checks bottom-up, continuation gates on progress, compaction suitability guards restart.
Node walk skips protected groups; protection scales by use; charging unwinds on failure.
Bulk free batches by locality; sheaf alloc checks node and lock; refill wins with atomic exchange and bounded slab picks.
Memblock isolate splits, table doubles page-aligned, find dispatches first-fit; percpu validates locality grouping and exact totals.
Distances prefill on first use; dirtyable nets reserves; shares scale with floors; limits rise fast and decay slowly.
CMA bitmap scales by order with locked clear and single-zone ranges; zones keep proportional cushions; compaction backoff caps at six.

locks.text: Zspage guard pairs lockdep with spin; movable marking needs exclusive guard; swap-cluster guard with IRQs off covers checks to detach.
Rotation holds node list guard with IRQs saved; mm iteration holds list spin; batch and min-seq need live lruvec lock.
Global shrink holds RCU only across lookup, drops over sleeping scan; barn and node use IRQ spin with try, never waits.
Global guard protects ratio shares; queue sampling holds list locks for walks; per-object locks guard bandwidth and shutdown; cgwb lock guards offline lists.
Cgwb guards trees, dropped over blocking work; BDI lock BH-safe; per-area spin guards bitmaps, mutex migration; early pfn holds early spin.

state_machines.text: Zspage init chains slots into tagged free list; rotation assigns random bin and moves nodes by age ops; ref check yields activate, keep or reclaim.
Generation advances directly or after full pass; max is single-winner; scan rotates zones to quota; node prefers stable path.
Per-vector enforces protection then young-tail-success; walk defers rotation and aborts fast; leak shutdown is single-shot; slab gate is monotonic to up.
Emulation sizes, carves and rebuilds with restore; teardown queues release, unlinks offline and defers free via RCU.
Device moves allocated to registered to released; activation validates zones and pageblocks, unwinding on failure.
Debug records move allocated and queued to split and requeued, driven by write values with larger records consumed whole first.

structs.text: Zspage chains descriptors with back-pointers and huge marker; thresholds form ordered array; vector lookup falls back to global.
Control holds targets and accumulators; gen store indexes by generation, type and zone; mm tracking is build-gated with fallback.
Object ref packs frame with class and index; shrink control carries budget; counter carries limits; sheaf carries main, spare and barn queues.
Percpu chunk sizes bitmaps hiding partial granules; memblock removal shifts tails; NUMA lists hold counted spans with reserved twins.
Writeback carries group links and flags; backing adds ids, ratios and trees; extent holds base and bitmap; area adds tallies and locks.
